scope: Finite observed trace checks, not universal correctness, mathematical optimality, device utilization or independently authenticated evidence.

trace_integrity.reason: Recorded identity and contiguous-sequence checks; missing or partial streams cannot prove absence.

stage_causality.reason: Each observed attempt must prepare, infer and encode/validate in causal order; failed/cancelled prefixes may stop early.

terminal_receipt_coverage.reason: All event-observed jobs and model execution attempts must reconcile to terminal job receipts; omitted receipts are unknown, not success.

model_ready_gate.reason: GPU stages require preceding same-instance model.ready without observed capability revocation. Drain/stop requests close admission but do not revoke already-admitted work by themselves.

gpu_stage_exclusivity.reason: Observed GPU stage scopes do not intersect; this is not a CUDA kernel occupancy measurement.

cross_task_cpu_gpu_overlap.reason: Positive interval intersection is witnessed by the single model event order. No overlap in a finite workload does not disprove the capability.

stage_durations.reason: Same model-instance monotonic host scopes only; wall clocks and different hosts are not subtracted.

sampled_resource_budgets.reason: Sampled scheduler reservations versus declared CPU/RAM/disk limits; not physical utilization or proof between samples.

observed_stage_cpu_budget.reason: Concurrent stage-declared CPU lanes; event scopes can omit acquire/release margins and are not sampled physical CPU use.

queued_cancel_not_dispatched.reason: Only explicitly declared queued-cancel targets are tested; cancellation after dispatch is a different contract.

terminal_job_cleanup.reason: Terminal API receipts attest attempt-local cleanup; they do not release the model process or cloud VM.

service_process_cleanup.reason: Matching final service state and process-owner exit, bound to manager_launcher_pid and a recorded process generation; not platform deallocation.

platform_release.reason: Separate dated platform observation explicitly bound to this manager lifetime. The analyzer cannot authenticate the external observation or its evidence hash.
